_comment: cloud-ci-anti-drift-drift-grep policy (DATA). Root/hub/freeze enumerations live ONLY at specs/integ-branch-envelopes.json — this pack cites JSON pointers and MUST NOT re-list. Producer supplies ADR-0711 + PORTABLE prose as DATA; the Rust evaluator REFUSEs dual-truth enumerations (INV-DOC-2). Born under ci/facade/affected-target-set to avoid Cargo.lock hub churn + registry/catalog adjunct (new package would require both).

product_contract.fail_closed: Pointer mismatch, gate_id mismatch, malformed cite list, forbidden prose enumeration, or missing required cite on an in-scope Swarm surface => Verdict::Refuse.
product_contract.born_pack_shaped: Required cite pointers are never hardcoded as an authority fork; load from envelopes #anti_drift.prose_must_cite_not_enumerate when present. Forbidden patterns are mechanical detectors (not a re-list of roots/hubs).
product_contract.scope: Only ADR-0711 / PORTABLE surfaces that carry Amendment D / INV-DOC-2 markers are evaluated. Absent surfaces on a parked tip are not a silent dual-truth green for fixtures — fixtures bind independently; live bind skips when files absent (require_surfaces=false).
